scope: Make one isolated recovery attempt for the provider-invalid Flash result on Polyglot without rerunning three verified successes

recovery_design.trigger: Flash returned no tokens and timed out at the provider target on the initial call and one bounded retry.
recovery_design.outcome_selection_guard: The only provider-invalid route is recovered once and no verified route is rerun.
recovery_design.retry_stop_rule: If this isolated recovery also returns a provider error, retain it as deployment-reliability evidence and do not retry indefinitely.
recovery_design.isolation_correction: Run Flash alone so provider availability cannot delay or cancel other routes.

effective_limits.wall_timeout_clock: absolute Unix wall time; includes laptop sleep

sandbox_budget.pricing_basis: same Daytona linear resource rates frozen for Gate 8 Wave 1
sandbox_budget.execution_policy: one isolated Harbor trial followed by a zero-sandbox cleanup check

interpretation_guard: Merge a learning-valid recovery row with the three preserved verified rows; a repeated provider error remains deployment evidence, not a capability failure.
